description: Opt-in skills-update lane. With this file at .github/skills-update-lane.json on the default branch, the review-gate status passes the update workflow's own PR (opened by one of `authors` from `branch` in this repo, with its head pushed by one of `authors`) on both the CODEOWNERS and the review halves, but only when every changed and renamed-from path is skills-lock.json or inside a tag-pinned skill's folder (a skills-lock.json entry whose ref is vX.Y.Z), under .agents/skills/<name>/ or .claude/skills/<name>/. Branch-tracking skills never qualify. Copy it with: cp .agents/skills/resolve-pr-concerns/references/skills-update-lane.example.json .github/skills-update-lane.json
